cat > /tmp/add_opts.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak1')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
ifaces = root.find('interfaces')

def add_iface(name, if_, ip, subnet):
    el = ifaces.find(name)
    if el is None:
        el = ET.SubElement(ifaces, name)
    def set_(tag, val):
        e = el.find(tag)
        if e is None:
            e = ET.SubElement(el, tag)
        e.text = val
    set_('enable', '1')
    set_('if', if_)
    set_('ipaddr', ip)
    set_('subnet', subnet)
    set_('descr', name.upper())

add_iface('opt1', 'vtnet1', '10.50.1.1', '24')
add_iface('opt2', 'vtnet2', '10.50.2.1', '24')

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('done')
PY

commands.command:
cat > /tmp/add_rule.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak2')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
filt = root.find('filter')
if filt is None:
    filt = ET.SubElement(root, 'filter')

rule = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
ET.SubElement(rule, 'type').text = 'pass'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'interface').text = 'opt1'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'protocol').text = 'tcp'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: allow lan-a to node3 tcp/8080 only'
src = ET.SubElement(rule, 'source')
ET.SubElement(src, 'network').text = 'opt1'
dst = ET.SubElement(rule, 'destination')
ET.SubElement(dst, 'address').text = '10.50.2.2'
ET.SubElement(dst, 'port').text = '8080'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('rule added')
PY
python3 /tmp/add_rule.py
commands.stdout: rule added
